stories.subject: Yeat / Luh Leakyz Vol. 1
stories.summary: Yeat released the 14-track Luh Leakyz Vol. 1 on Oct. 23 as a collection of fan-demanded songs from across his catalog; the release is his third project of 2026 and connects to his Fortnite collaboration.

stories.subject: Wiz Khalifa / 10K Projects
stories.summary: Wiz Khalifa signed with 10K Projects and released The Calm, returning to the Warner Music Group family and reuniting with Marsha St. Hubert, now a 10K co-president; album timing remains unannounced.

stories.subject: Yung Miami / Breakfast Club denial
stories.summary: Yung Miami denied on The Breakfast Club that she transported drugs for Sean Combs, calling the allegation false while discussing the reputational and business fallout around it.

stories.subject: DaBaby and DaniLeigh custody agreement
stories.summary: DaBaby and DaniLeigh executed a 13-page agreement covering custody and monthly support for their five-year-old daughter Velour; the amount and parenting schedule remain private.

stories.subject: GTA VI real-world beer label filings
stories.summary: Public U.S. Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau records show Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City labels filed by Florida brewer Tripping Animals; neither Rockstar nor the brewer has confirmed retail release or a partnership.

note: Five distinct Oct. 24, 2026 5 PM Pacific rap/GTA VI stories, each cross-checked against at least two current sources; legal and unconfirmed-marketing copy preserves the reported status.
